reviews.title: Awesome Monitor!
reviews.comment: I've had this monitor for over a year now and its held up through everything the color quality is amazing and is pumping 360 Hz daily. In terms of brightness its 30x better than my old MSI monitor and for the price I got it as was very much a steal. Love this monitor and wouldn't mind another so that i can dual wield them lmaoo.
reviews.author: Max
